scope: Exploratory necessary spatial consistency test of retained assignments and unchanged fan.
measured_markers: C brightness crest and E brightness edge; physical assignments unestablished
assumed_assignments: C=outer fast shock, E=contact; same affine 1D image mapping for all waves
conclusion: With these two assignments and the unchanged fan, a common affine mapping cannot put the rarefaction inside B from the second selected epoch onward, including any uniform frame boost.
limitations: Necessary condition only; satisfying it would not establish a temporally consistent Riemann map.
C and E are used as conditional anchors, not independent validation targets in this test.
No dark quantile is identified with a physical rarefaction boundary.
Aperture non-overlap does not exclude a rarefaction elsewhere or downstream plasma advected out of a rarefaction.
Curvature, non-affine projection, line-of-sight mixing and alternative state/feature assignments are not ruled out.
The 12 processing variants are dependent sensitivity tests, not a statistical confidence interval.
This is a post-hoc algebraic follow-up to a failed mapping, not preregistered evidence or a new wave detection.
